title: Königrufen
bidPhase: Auction — declare the Rufer (King-calling) contract, or pass.
callPhase: Call a King — choose the King's suit to call. Whoever holds that King becomes your secret partner (you cannot call a King you hold yourself).
talonPhase: Talon exchange — bury 6 cards from your hand ({{count}}/6 selected). Kings and the Trull honours (trumps 1, 21, and the Sküs) cannot be buried.
talonRestricted: This card cannot be buried (King / Trull honour).

hint.lead_low: As a defender, lead low to conserve strength
hint.follow_win: You can win this trick — take it
hint.follow_duck: Cannot win or not worth it — duck

tutorial.trickDisplay: The current trick. You must follow the led suit; if you cannot, you must play a trump (tarock); failing that, any card. The highest trump wins the trick.
tutorial.playerHand: Your hand. Click a legal card to select it. Königrufen is a 4-player trick-taker on the 54-card tarock deck (four 8-card suits, 21 trumps, and the Sküs).
tutorial.playButton: Once a card is selected, play it with this button. In the auction you pass or declare the Rufer; in the call phase you pick the King's suit to call; in the talon phase you bury 6 cards.
tutorial.info: Königrufen is a 4-player trick-taker on the 54-card tarock deck. Once the auction settles the declarer, calling a King makes whoever holds it the declarer's secret partner (their identity stays hidden until that King is first played). The declarer merges the 6-card talon into hand, buries 6 cards, and partners up against the other two. The declaring team wins the deal by capturing enough card-points. The player with the highest cumulative score after the set number of deals wins.
tutorial.resetButton: Use the reset button to start a new game.
